objectives.text: Recognize which Java release a feature needs, such as lambdas (8), var (10), switch expressions (14) and records (16)
Rewrite an older idiom, such as an anonymous class or a colon switch, in its modern form
Read code written for Java 8, 11 or 17 and predict that it still compiles on JDK 25

minutes.basis: Intake planning budget for a review page under the new-course rule in docs/tools/validators.md (B8): no artifact.html exists yet, so modeledP50 and modeledWorstPath are 0 (not measured), not estimates. The planning value is the largest ceil(max(estimator P50, worst path)) measured on a course-1 page (10 minutes, agile-scrum-user-stories). The module PR measures the authored page with the frozen estimator, models the worst required path, and raises budget and aboutLabel to at least ceil(max(P50, modeledWorstPath)), at most 15, without compressing other topics. See evidence/java-foundations/intake.md, section Minute budgets.
